items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Anyway thank you very much, Monk, appreciate it.

ctx.x: And I wish you the best with your myriad of projects, and working on your vowels and the consonants.
Oh, so much to do, so little time. So much to do, so little time. See there was no b’s in there. Anyway thank you very much, Monk, appreciate it.
Okay. Thanks for your time. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -16-
